steps.title: Drawn from a full bottle
steps.text: Every decant starts with an authentic full bottle. A sterile syringe draws the fragrance straight from it, and the tools are cleaned between fragrances so scents never mix.

steps.title: Into a new glass atomizer
steps.text: Each decant goes into a brand-new Evrair atomizer: a pressurized glass bottle with a gold metal sprayer crimped on. Atomizers are never reused.

steps.title: Labelled, sealed and packed
steps.text: Labelled with the house and the fragrance, sealed so it can’t leak in the mail, and packed to travel safely.

sections.title: What we collect
text: When you place an order, we collect the details you give us to complete it, such as your name, delivery address and email address.
When you write to us through the contact form, we collect your name, email address, your message and any files you attach.
When you browse the shop, our hosting provider automatically receives your device’s internet protocol (IP) address and basic details about your browser and operating system.

sections.title: How we use it
text: We use your information to process and deliver your order, to answer your messages, and to run and improve the shop.
We only send you emails about the shop, new decants or other news if you’ve agreed to receive them, and you can stop them at any time.

sections.title: Your consent
text: When you give us your information to place an order, arrange delivery or ask a question, you agree to our using it for that purpose only.
If we want to use your information for anything else, such as marketing, we’ll ask you first or give you a clear way to say no.
You can withdraw your consent at any time, for us to contact you or to keep collecting, using or sharing your information, by emailing {email}.

sections.title: When we share it
text: We share your information only with the services we need to run the shop, such as hosting, payments and delivery, or when the law requires us to.

sections.title: Shopify
text: Our store is hosted on Shopify Inc., which provides the online platform we use to sell our decants to you. Your information is kept in Shopify’s data storage, databases and general application, on secure servers protected by a firewall.

Payments: if you pay through a direct payment gateway, Shopify stores your card details, encrypted to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS). Your transaction details are kept only as long as needed to complete your purchase, and are then deleted.

Every direct payment gateway follows the PCI-DSS standards managed by the PCI Security Standards Council, a joint effort of Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover. These standards help make sure card information is handled securely by us and our service providers.
To learn more, read Shopify’s [Terms of Service](https://www.shopify.com/legal/terms) and [Privacy Statement](https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy).

sections.title: Other services
text: The other services we use collect, use and share your information only as far as they need to provide their service to us.

Some of them, such as payment gateways and other payment processors, have their own privacy policies for the information we must give them to complete your purchase. We recommend reading those policies to understand how they handle your information.

Some of these services may be based, or have facilities, in a different country from you or from us. If your purchase uses one of them, your information may become subject to the laws of that country. For example, if you are in Canada and your payment is processed in the United States, your information may be subject to United States law.
Once you leave our shop or are sent to another website or app, this privacy policy no longer applies.
Links on our shop may take you to other websites. We aren’t responsible for how those sites handle privacy, and we encourage you to read their privacy statements.

sections.title: Security
text: We take reasonable steps and follow standard industry practice so your personal information isn’t lost, misused, accessed, shared, changed or destroyed without permission.

Card details are encrypted while they travel to the payment provider. No way of sending or storing information over the internet is completely secure, but we follow the PCI-DSS requirements and other widely accepted industry standards.

sections.title: Cookies and your browser
text: Shopify sets cookies that keep your session and your cart working and count visits to the shop. You can choose to block cookies in your browser, though parts of the shop may then stop working.
Your bag, your wishlist and the decants you’ve viewed recently are kept in your own browser, so they’re still there when you come back. Clearing your browser’s data for this site removes them.

sections.title: Age of consent
text: By using this site, you confirm that you’ve reached the age of majority in your province or state of residence, or that you have, and you’ve allowed a minor in your care to use it.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
text: We may update this policy at any time, so please check it from time to time. Changes take effect as soon as they’re posted here, with the date at the top. If we make important changes, we’ll say so here.
If the shop is sold or merged with another business, your information may pass to the new owners so they can keep serving you.

sections.title: Questions and contact
text: To see, correct, change or delete the personal information we hold about you, to make a complaint, or to ask anything about this policy, email us at {email}.

text: We ship within Canada only.

text: Orders are posted from {location} with Canada Post or ICS ground shipping.

sections.title: Shipping options and costs
text: Lettermail: {lettermailCost}, free on orders from {lettermailFree}.

Lettermail is for small, flat parcels. Decants larger than {lettermailMaxMl} ml always go by tracked shipping.

sections.title: When your order ships
text: Every decant is poured to order. Your order is poured and posted within one to two business days.

sections.title: Complimentary sample
text: You can have one complimentary sample with your order on request. Tell us which one you’d like in your order note, or leave it to us and we’ll choose one we think you’ll enjoy based on your order.

sections.title: Refunds
text: Because decants are poured to order, we can’t accept returns once an order has shipped.

If your order arrives damaged, or you’re not happy with the quality of the materials used for your decants, [contact us](/contact) and we’ll help you with a replacement order or store credit as a gift card.
